title: My best friend
subtitle: Tea with Rose — have and has
canDo: I can say what people have: I have a brother, she has a cat.
I can describe how people look: long hair, brown eyes.
I can write a short text about my best friend.
teacherNotes: Ünitenin son dersi: "My best friend" yazısını ödev olarak verin ve size göndermelerini isteyin (Copy my text).
Türk öğrenciler "var" yüzünden "There is a brother of me" gibi cümleler kurabilir. Sahiplik = have / has.
hair sayılamaz: "a long hair" değil "long hair". Hem Türk hem Arap öğrencilerde çok sık görülür.
Bu derste sadece olumlu cümle var. "Do you have…?" sorusu Ünite 3'te (do / does) geliyor; şimdilik kalıp olarak geçin.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: My best friend
sections.intro: Lucas writes about his best friend.
paragraphs: He has short brown hair and a beard.
Pedro has a small music shop.
He has a lot of guitars — old guitars, new guitars, big guitars and small guitars!
He's in Brazil, but we have a video call every Sunday.

sections.title: Grammar: have / has
rules: Use have / has for family, things and how people look: She **has** brown eyes.
**hair** is one thing: She has long hair. (Don't say “a long hair”.)

support.tr: Türkçede sahip olmayı "-im var" ile söyleriz: Bir kardeşim var. İngilizcede have / has kullanılır: I have a brother. he / she / it ile has olur: She has a cat = Onun bir kedisi var. Görünüş için de kullanılır: She has long hair = Uzun saçları var.
support.ar: في العربية نقول: «عندي أخ» أو «لديّ أخ». في الإنجليزية نستخدم الفعل have: I have a brother. ومع he / she / it نقول has: She has a cat = عندها قطّة. ونستخدمه أيضًا للوصف: She has long hair = شعرها طويل.

tr.note: "Var" deyince there is'e kaçma; sahiplik için have / has kullan. Saç (hair) sayılamaz, a almaz.
wrong: There is a brother of me.

ar.note: مع he / she / it استخدم has وليس have، ولا تضع a قبل hair.
